leadText:
Cleopatra Island (Japanese: クレオパトラ島 Cleopatra Island) is an island in the Orange Islands.

It appeared in Charizard Chills. Tad challenged to a with his . After it defeated , it then . Fearing for its life, Ash stayed up all night with his Pokémon, making sure Charizard would be okay. After Charizard recovered, Ash had a rematch with Tad and proved victorious.

Although Cleopatra Island is large, only the beach was shown.
